extracted.intended_audience: Researchers reporting health economic evaluations; peer reviewers and journal editors assessing such manuscripts
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and reviewing health economic evaluation manuscripts so they are identifiable, interpretable, and useful for decision making, using the 28-item CHEERS 2022 checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title and Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear identification of the type of analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the title and abstract explicitly identify the study as a health economic evaluation and state the type of analysis used; reviewers should check completeness of identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the study background and specific objectives so readers can understand the decision problem and purpose of the economic evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health economic analysis plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether an analysis plan existed and provide key elements; reviewers should look for prespecification of methods and analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study population
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the population to whom the results apply (eligibility criteria, relevant characteristics) so applicability and generalizability can be judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting and location
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the setting and geographical location(s) of the study to contextualize costs and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparators
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly define the interventions or strategies being compared and justify their selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perspective
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the analytical perspective (e.g., healthcare system, societal) and justify its choice, as perspective determines which costs and outcomes are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time horizon
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the time horizon over which costs and outcomes are measured, with rationale for its appropriateness to capture relevant effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discount rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report discount rates used for costs and outcomes and justify the choice; ensure methods for discounting are transparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe which outcomes were selected for the evaluation and the rationale for their selection, linked to the decision problem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement of outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how outcomes were measured (data sources, instruments, timing) so readers can assess validity and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valuation of outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report methods used to value outcomes (e.g., utilities, willingness-to-pay) and the sources or procedures used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement and valuation of resources and costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Measurement and valuation of resources and costs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how resource use and costs were measured and valued, including data sources, unit costs, and methods of valuation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency, price date, and conversion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the currency used, the price date for cost data, and methods for currency conversion or inflation adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rationale and description of model
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a model is used, provide the rationale for model choice and a clear description of model structure, key inputs, and assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytics and assumptions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe analytic methods (e.g., statistical analyses, model calibration) and key assumptions made in the analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterising heterogeneity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report analyses examining variation in costs or outcomes across subgroups and how heterogeneity was assessed and interpreted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterising distributional effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe any assessment of distributional impacts (equity considerations) and methods used to characterise how benefits and costs are distributed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterising uncertainty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report approaches to characterising uncertainty (e.g., deterministic sensitivity analysis, probabilistic sensitivity analysis) and present their impact on conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach to engagement with patients and others affected by the study
rubrics_metrics.description: Approach to engagement with patients and others affected by the study
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe stakeholder engagement (including patients and the public), how stakeholders were involved, and how their input influenced design, conduct, or interpretation; CHEERS 2022 emphasises increased role of stakeholder involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study parameters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present key parameter values used in the analysis (inputs, sources, and ranges) so results can be scrutinised and replicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of main results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear summary of the principal findings including costs, outcomes, and any incremental comparisons relevant to decision making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of uncertainty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present how uncertainty affects results (e.g., confidence intervals, probabilistic sensitivity analysis) and implications for decision making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of engagement with patients
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report how patient and stakeholder engagement affected results, interpretation, or dissemination of findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study findings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss the main findings in the context of the study question and existing evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state study limitations, potential biases, and how they might affect conclusions and applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generalizability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss the extent to which findings are generalisable to other settings, populations, or decision contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current knowledge
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place study results in the context of current knowledge and policy implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source of funding
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report funding sources and the role of funders in study design, analysis, interpretation, and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose any conflicts of interest for authors and contributors that could influence the study or interpretation.
